First, we apply the power of quotient rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{2x}{3})}^{4}=\frac{(2x)^{4}}{{3}^{4}}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the power rule and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(2x)^{4}}{{3}^{4}} & = \\ \frac{{2}^{4}{x}^{4}}{{3}^{4}} & = \\ \frac{16{x}^{4}}{81} & \end{aligned}
$$
